gate_1_reproducibility.name: Complete Reproducibility
gate_1_reproducibility.required_threshold: 100% deterministic code, fixed seed replication, all checkpoints & scripts preserved
gate_1_reproducibility.observed_value: Linear fusion head is strictly deterministic; 5-seed std is 0.00%; all data keyed and scripts preserved
gate_1_reproducibility.rationale: Exact code, data keys, and prediction hashes are fully reproducible.

gate_2_leakage_safety.name: Zero Data Contamination & Leakage Safety
gate_2_leakage_safety.required_threshold: Quarantined official test set used ZERO times; 0% entity overlap in Dual-Unseen validation
gate_2_leakage_safety.observed_value: Official test accessed 0 times; Dual-Unseen split guard verified 0 resume/job overlap; row 46 near-duplicate quarantined
gate_2_leakage_safety.rationale: Strict protocol split guard confirmed zero leakage across candidate resumes and job postings.

gate_3_statistically_significant_improve.name: Statistical or Meaningful Improvement
gate_3_statistically_significant_improve.required_threshold: Statistically significant improvement over baseline under paired hypothesis test and two-way clustering
gate_3_statistically_significant_improve.observed_value: McNemar exact p=0.0125 (<0.05); CGM 95% CI [0.60, 13.59] pp strictly excludes zero; Macro F1 bootstrap CI [0.0014, 0.1798] strictly positive; but accuracy bootstrap CI [-2.98, 16.58] pp crosses zero
gate_3_statistically_significant_improve.rationale: Significance holds under McNemar exact test and analytical CGM two-way sandwich, but Owen crossed-cluster bootstrap dispersion crosses zero on accuracy delta. Directional superiority is proven (+7.09 pp, 43 wins vs 22 losses), but statistical significance is conditional on the cluster dispersion model.

gate_4_good_fit_recall_improvement.name: Good Fit Recall Improvement
gate_4_good_fit_recall_improvement.required_threshold: Substantial improvement in identifying high-quality matches without collapsing to No Fit
gate_4_good_fit_recall_improvement.observed_value: Good Fit recall increased from 15.05% (14/93) to 26.88% (25/93), a +78.57% relative improvement, with 40.32% precision (25/62)
gate_4_good_fit_recall_improvement.rationale: Overcomes historical Good Fit collapse without precision degradation.

gate_5_inference_latency.name: Inference Latency Limit
gate_5_inference_latency.observed_value: End-to-end single-pair CPU latency: Mean 374.343 ms, p50 506.397 ms, p95 587.141 ms. Precomputed-feature classification head alone is 4.47 ms.
gate_5_inference_latency.rationale: Complete end-to-end single-pair inference on CPU (including SBERT encoding and domain regex extraction) takes ~374 ms per pair, exceeding the 50 ms SLA. Would require GPU, batching, or precomputed embedding caching to meet sub-50ms target.

gate_6_model_size_and_memory.name: Model Size & Memory Limit
gate_6_model_size_and_memory.required_threshold: <= 50 MB total deployable artifact size and peak RAM
gate_6_model_size_and_memory.observed_value: Total deployable artifact size: 174.07 MB (SBERT weights: 174.0 MB, classifier head: 76.4 KB). Peak process RSS: 637.09 MB.
gate_6_model_size_and_memory.rationale: The deployable model requires SBERT transformer weights (174 MB) and PyTorch runtime (~637 MB peak RSS), exceeding the 50 MB standalone lightweight edge budget.

gate_7_probability_calibration.name: Probability Calibration
gate_7_probability_calibration.required_threshold: Normalized Brier Score <= 0.35 OR Expected Calibration Error <= 0.15; No severe calibration degradation
gate_7_probability_calibration.observed_value: Normalized Brier Score: 0.3511 (raw 0.7022); ECE: 0.1896. Clean Baseline Brier: 0.3727; Baseline ECE: 0.2318.
gate_7_probability_calibration.rationale: Model 5 Normalized Brier Score is 0.3511 (borderline to the 0.35 target) and ECE is 0.1896 (> 0.15 SLA). Post-hoc temperature scaling or isotonic calibration is required prior to production exposure.

gate_8_no_class_degradation.name: No Degradation on Any Class
gate_8_no_class_degradation.required_threshold: No substantial degradation on any individual class F1, precision, or recall
gate_8_no_class_degradation.observed_value: No Fit recall: 59.35% vs 60.98% (-1.63 pp), but precision improved to 51.41% (+4.53 pp); Potential Fit F1: 0.3721 vs 0.2532 (+0.1189); Good Fit F1: 0.3226 vs 0.1854 (+0.1372)
gate_8_no_class_degradation.rationale: Small trade-off in No Fit recall (-1.6 pp) is heavily outweighed by substantial improvements across all three classes in F1, precision, and multi-class balance.
